Created using Celtx QUICK INTRO SEQ. A stack of pizza boxes placed on a countertop. A pizza shop door opens with a ping. A car door slams shut. An apartment doorbell rings. Pizza box. Shop door ping. Car door slam. Doorbell ring. Box. Ping. Slam. Ring. EXT. CHEVY LUMINA - DAY JERRY WAINWRIGHT, 21, rips a PIZZA PERFECTION car-topper off of his run-down 1998 Chevy Lumina. He enters the car and starts it. INT. CHEVY LUMINA - DAY Jerry wears a snow-covered COLD PIZZA CLUB hat, which he rips off, a winter coat, and jeans. He's a scruffy, white, weary- eyed college student. In the passenger seat, a heart shaped box of chocolates and a teddy bear. Jerry takes a puff of an e-cigarette and unlocks a smartphone attached to the dash. On it is an update for a voicemail. The clock reads 5:32. He grimaces and holds the phone to his ear. EXT. CHEVY LUMINA - DAY The car-topper gets thrown back on the car. A bag of pizzas thrown in the back. Time to go back to work. Pizza hat tugged back on. Jerry drives down the road looking tired. EXT. HOUSE - DAY He pulls up to a residential house, hefts his delivery bag out of his back seat and walks up to a house, angrily mumbling to himself. He pulls his phone out of his pocket and unlocks it. Jerry makes a call from his phone. He knocks on the door and turns around, holding the pizza. The call goes to voicemail.

# Page 2^page=2
2. Created using Celtx INT. APARTMENT COMPLEX - EVENING A pastel bedroom with vanity. KATE, mid 20's, wearing headphones, misses the call on her phone next to her. JERRY (voice over) Kate, just wanted to call and say I'm so sorry, I know it's Valentine's day but I got called back in - EXT. HOUSE - DAY The door opens. Jerry stuffs his phone in his pocket. A MIDDLE AGED MAN in the doorway, standing behind Jerry as he hangs up the call; Jerry turns to the man, forces a small smile on his face, hands him a pizza in exchange for a wad of cash and closes the door. INT. CHEVY LUMINA - DAY Jerry slams his car door. He grips his steering wheel in anger before checking his phone. No reply. He follows Google Maps to his next location. EXT. APARTMENT COMPLEX - EVENING Jerry pulls up to a bland, run-down apartment complex. He gets out of his car and carries his delivery bag across an icy walkway and knocks. No answer. He knocks again. Faintly, a repetitive bass line reverberates from within. He knocks one more time, and the door CREAKS open. INT. APARTMENT COMPLEX - EVENING A college apartment, completely obliterated. Tipped red solo cups, a keg, passed out young people, blasting music, and flashing lights. Jerry creeps in, tiptoeing through the detritus. He spies a young man, shirtless, on a couch. Across his face is a phallic doodle, along with "DAMIEN EATS DICK" written in sharpie. Jerry looks down at a receipt in his hand, that reads DAMIEN CLARK. He found the guy. Jerry nudges the body to no avail, pushing him with his shoe. Gently, he nudges his shoulder, but still, Damien lies unresponsive. Desperate, Jerry sets down his delivery bag, rifles through the guys pockets, finds his wallet. Behind

# Page 3^page=3
3. Created using Celtx him, a RATTLE. He spins around. A half-conscious WOMAN squints up at him from the floor. Jerry gestures to the pizza and places it on the ground. The woman nods. Jerry takes off with the money. EXT. SIDE STREET - EVENING Jerry hauling the Lumina down a slushy residential avenue. The car rounds a tight corner, and the back end SWERVES. The car gently careens into a snowbank on the side of the road. Jerry revs the engine, but the wheels spin in place. A beat. He gets out of the car, SLAMS the door. He stares at his situation in disbelief. He kicks at the snow around the tires, furious. The PING of a text message. INT. APARTMENT COMPLEX - EVENING Kate, in front of a mirror, trying on a dress and texting. TEXT Hey, Jer bear. Got your voice mail. Don't worry, take all the time you need. Be safe out there! :) EXT. SIDE STREET - EVENING - CONTINUOUS. He takes a deep breath. It's 7:02. Another ping. TEXT And just make sure you text me when you get off. Jerry, back in the car, having cleared the snow around it. He slowly turns the wheel, applies the gas, and pulls out of the bank. EXT. HIGH-END APARTMENTS - NIGHT Jerry, delivery bag in hand, shuts his car door and wanders the complex, looking for the building. The receipt reads "Building D room 204". Jerry climbs up a concrete staircase with the bag. Faint music again, and laughing voices from above. Room 204. Jerry knocks. The music stops. The door swings open. Inside, a shirtless, mustached LEWIS BAKER. He smiles. Jerry

# Page 4^page=4
4. Created using Celtx takes out the last pizza and looks up. LEWIS Got us Pizza, babe! Behind Lewis, wearing nothing but an overly long t-shirt, is KATE, eating a piece of cake. She stands in shock. Jerry covers his mouth. KATE (between bites) He made me do it. Kate walks into another room. Lewis looks puzzled. Jerry hands Lewis the pizza, makes him sign the receipt, and walks away, exhausted and hurt, down the concrete stairs. INT. CHEVY LUMINA - NIGHT Jerry takes off his hat and throws it in the back. Closes his eyes, takes a puff of his e-cig, and turns on the radio. EXT. HIGH-END APARTMENTS - NIGHT A box of chocolates and a teddy bear thrown into the snow from the car. FADE OUT. THE END.
